# Designing Data-Intensive Applications for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/data-intensive-apps/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/data-intensive-apps
```

- 38 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/data-intensive-apps:data-intensive-apps-<name>`.
- 22 subagents, started with `@data-intensive-apps-<name> <task>`.
